title: Iso-heart-rate, cross-corpus evaluation of wrist-wearable stress detection (analysis code)
description:
Analysis code for an iso-heart-rate, cross-corpus evaluation of binary stress-versus-non-stress detection from wrist-worn Empatica E4 recordings across the WESAD, Stress-Predict and Nurse corpora.

Includes the iso-HR matching procedure, leave-one-subject-out and leave-one-dataset-out protocols, four unsupervised domain-adaptation baselines (CORAL, subspace alignment, transfer component analysis, importance weighting), an accelerometer context-aware transfer model, leave-one-dataset-out error stratification, and the reviewer-requested robustness analyses (non-overlapping and 300 s windows, HRV ablation, label-alignment sensitivity, feature-shift analysis, Nurse operational metrics).

No dataset is redistributed. Each corpus must be obtained from its original source under its own licence.
